throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --asm 'ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0; ibar 0'
throughput.notes: 8 instruction barriers take 137.00 cycles in the sample, but the cost is not stable: repeated runs on different cores and with different barrier counts give roughly 17.1-20.7 CPI. The variation is consistent with ibar waiting on pipeline/uncore state rather than a fixed core-cycle count, so the range is recorded instead of a single integer.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput is variable: observed range about 17.1-20.7 CPI depending on core/frequency/system state.
